lessons.correction: Strengthen ground forces, increase defense, continue economy growth, and increase technology. Maintain air and expansion.
lessons.mistake: Tempting to over-commit to air or neglect defense, or expand too greedily without scouting.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate when your army composition becomes clearer or if the opponent shows signs of tech switches.
lessons.title: Avoid over-committing to air or neglecting defense
lessons.when: Early game, own army composition unknown, heavy technology investment, moderate production, heavy defense. Opponent shows ground posture with Zergling and Queen cues, moderate production, light technology.
lessons.why: With an unknown own army and possible early Zergling pressure, prioritizing defense and ground strength while teching up is a safe way to transition into a stronger midgame.

lessons.correction: Increase defense and economy, strengthen ground forces, continue production and tech. Maintain air and expansion.
lessons.mistake: Tempting to be too passive, missing opportunities to gain map control or punish over-expansion.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate when your army composition becomes clear or if the opponent shows signs of tech switches.
lessons.title: Avoid being too passive; seek map control
lessons.when: Early-midgame, own army unknown, heavy tech, moderate production, heavy defense. Opponent ground posture with Zergling and Queen cues, moderate production, light tech.
lessons.why: As the game progresses, stabilizing your defense and economy while continuing tech development prepares you for a strong midgame transition.

lessons.correction: Strengthen ground forces, continue production and tech, maintain defense and economy. Do not over-expand.
lessons.mistake: Tempting to neglect air defense if opponent techs to Mutalisks; also risk over-expanding.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate if the opponent shows signs of air tech or if your army composition needs adjustment.
lessons.title: Avoid neglecting air defense if opponent techs to Mutalisks
lessons.when: Midgame, own army ground-oriented with Stalkers and Oracles, heavy production and tech. Opponent ground posture with Zerglings, Queens, and Overseers, heavy production and tech.
lessons.why: With a defined ground army, focusing on strengthening it while maintaining a solid economy is key to matching the opponent's heavy production.
